topic: During load-shedding, slow footsteps walk on the rooftop of a house where nobody lives upstairs.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: Footsteps Above

shots.narration: Nobody lived upstairs, but the footsteps came every night.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, 3D animated film look; old Pakistani haveli courtyard at night, beneath a dark rooftop, no text.
shots.action: Saad points toward the rooftop beside Bashir's brass lantern.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, low fog, warm lantern glow, deep rooftop shadows.

shots.narration: Bashir told Saad about a house on his old patrol.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, courtyard bench beside Bashir's old brass lantern; grey beard, brown woollen shawl, white cap; Saad wears a dark green hoodie and jeans.
shots.action: Bashir gestures toward a distant empty house.
shots.mood: Quiet storytelling circle, amber light against a blue-black village.

shots.narration: [whispers] During load-shedding, he heard slow steps above its empty rooms.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, story location: deserted Pakistani house veranda, unlit electric bulb, cracked plaster, flat rooftop.
shots.action: Bashir raises his lantern toward the veranda ceiling.
shots.mood: Thick darkness, narrow amber illumination, looming ceiling.

shots.narration: The staircase entrance had been bricked shut.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, interior corridor ending at a stairway arch completely filled with old bricks.
shots.action: Bashir presses one palm against the brickwork.
shots.mood: Dusty mortar, heavy shadows, sealed and undisturbed.

shots.narration: With every step overhead, dust fell from the ceiling.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, empty ground-floor room with bare plaster ceiling and an unlit hanging bulb.
shots.action: Small puffs of ceiling dust fall in a slow advancing line.
shots.mood: Lantern-lit dust, oppressive stillness, deliberate invisible movement.

shots.narration: [sighs] He fetched a ladder from the courtyard.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, enclosed courtyard beneath the house's flat roof, old wooden ladder against a wall.
shots.mood: Pale moonlight, long ladder shadow, anxious determination.

shots.narration: He climbed outside, expecting someone on the roof.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, exterior wall of the deserted house, ladder reaching the rooftop parapet, lantern secured at Bashir's waist.
shots.mood: Towering wall, moonlit fog, fragile pool of lantern light.

shots.narration: But the rooftop dust lay perfectly smooth.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, completely empty flat rooftop with an unbroken layer of fine dust and a low parapet.
shots.action: Bashir sweeps his lantern over the untouched dust.
shots.mood: Exposed moonlight, empty space, no footprints anywhere.

shots.narration: [surprised] Then the footsteps moved directly beneath his feet.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, same empty rooftop, lantern light falling around Bashir's sandals.
shots.action: Bashir crouches with one palm against the roof.
shots.mood: Close, airless tension despite the open night sky.

shots.narration: Downstairs, he finally looked at the ceiling.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, ground-floor room again, bare ceiling above Bashir, ladder visible outside the open doorway.
shots.mood: Rising amber light, ceiling emerging slowly from blackness.

shots.narration: Bare footprints pressed outward, walking upside down toward him.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bare plaster ceiling directly above Bashir; no figure visible.
shots.action: A sequence of foot-shaped bulges presses through the ceiling toward Bashir.
shots.mood: Grotesquely stretched plaster without damage, enormous shadows, peak supernatura

shots.narration: [whispers] Tomorrow, they'll open the lantern; those footsteps are inside now.
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, return to the haveli courtyard storytelling bench, Bashir and Saad beside the closed brass lantern.
shots.action: The lantern's closed lid lifts a fraction from within.
shots.mood: Thin seam of amber light, frozen listeners, surrounding darkness.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow, Bashir and Saad must open the lantern.
episode.description: During load-shedding, Bashir Chacha heard footsteps above an empty house. By lantern light, he tells Saad why checking the rooftop only made things worse. A fictional spooky story from Midnight Watch.
